chunks: With this chain, from al-Hasan, from his father, from Abi Basir, from Abi Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

One who recites 'Tabarak Alladhi biyadihi al-mulk' in the written [Quran] before sleeping will remain in Allah's protection until morning, and in His protection on the Day of Resurrection until he enters Paradise.

key_terms.الْمَكْتُوبَةِ: Al-maktubah (the written [Quran]), referring to the Mushaf
key_terms.تَبَارَكَ الَّذِي بِيَدِهِ الْمُلْكُ: Tabarak Alladhi biyadihi al-mulk (The Blessed One in whose hand is the dominion), referring to Surah Al-Mulk

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for reciting Surah Mulk before sleeping according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Compiled by Shaykh al-Saduq in *Thawab al-A'mal*, this hadith emphasizes the protective power of Surah Al-Mulk as a nightly spiritual shield, linking immediate safety during sleep with enduring divine safeguarding on the Day of Judgment. The chain of narration through Abu Abdillah (Imam al-Sadiq) underscores the Imami tradition of viewing this Surah as the 'intercessor' for its reciter, ensuring deliverance from the grave and entry into Paradise.
